meta.note: Alert template library. Each template has an INTRUSION reading and a BENIGN twin using the same detection rule and the same telemetry shape. Slots in braces are filled at assembly time. No template carries evaluation-environment or GenAI naming; that framing appears only in condition D. Alerts are telemetry descriptions only: counts, times, process names, destinations, rule names. No commands or exploit detail.

provenance_key.elastic: Named rule shipped in the Elastic detection-rules repository
provenance_key.sigma: Public rule in the SigmaHQ repository
provenance_key.custom: Custom check, no public equivalent found

meta.excluded: Elastic's GenAI-prefixed rule family is deliberately excluded. Those rule names identify the activity as AI-driven, which would place the condition D attribution inside the condition B telemetry.

templates.rule: DNS Enumeration Detected via Defend for Containers
templates.intrusion: {n} unique lookups in {mins} min from one container. Pool baseline 8-20/hr. All resolved to internal mirror subdomains.
templates.benign: {n} unique lookups in {mins} min from one container. Pool baseline 8-20/hr. All resolved to internal mirror subdomains.
templates.benign_cause: monorepo dependency upgrade resolving a large tree

templates.rule: Kubernetes Multi-Resource Discovery
templates.intrusion: {n} API requests across {k} resource types in {mins} min. {pct}% returned 403. Same user agent throughout.
templates.benign: {n} API requests across {k} resource types in {mins} min. {pct}% returned 403. Same user agent throughout.
templates.benign_cause: new monitoring agent enumerating visible resources with an under-scoped role

templates.rule: Kubernetes Forbidden Request from Unusual User Agent
templates.intrusion: {n} denied requests from user agent '{ua}', not previously seen in this cluster.
templates.benign: {n} denied requests from user agent '{ua}', not previously seen in this cluster.
templates.benign_cause: a vendor agent rolled out this week with a client library that sets its own user agent

templates.rule: Kubernetes Suspicious Self-Subject Review via Unusual User Agent
templates.intrusion: SelfSubjectRulesReview called {n} times in {mins} min by service account {sa}.
templates.benign: SelfSubjectRulesReview called {n} times in {mins} min by service account {sa}.
templates.benign_cause: a controller checking its own permissions on startup, retrying after a config reload

templates.rule: Internal service port sweep
templates.intrusion: Connection attempts to {k} distinct internal ports across {h} hosts in {mins} min. {pct}% refused.
templates.benign: Connection attempts to {k} distinct internal ports across {h} hosts in {mins} min. {pct}% refused.
templates.benign_cause: service mesh sidecar retrying endpoints during a partial rollout

templates.rule: Kubernetes Direct API Request via Curl or Wget
templates.intrusion: API server contacted directly by curl from container {ctr}, {n} requests.
templates.benign: API server contacted directly by curl from container {ctr}, {n} requests.
templates.benign_cause: a debug container left running by an engineer investigating a failing job

templates.rule: Suspicious Interpreter Execution Detected via Defend for Containers
templates.intrusion: python3.11 -> /bin/sh. Parent PID owned by the job runner.
templates.benign: python3.11 -> /bin/sh. Parent PID owned by the job runner.
templates.benign_cause: a build script shelling out, which happens thousands of times a day in this pool

templates.rule: Inline Python Execution - Spawn Shell Via OS System Library
templates.intrusion: Shell spawned via python os.system on {host}, {n} occurrences in {mins} min.
templates.benign: Shell spawned via python os.system on {host}, {n} occurrences in {mins} min.
templates.benign_cause: a legacy test harness that shells out per test case

templates.rule: Python Spawning Pretty TTY
templates.intrusion: Interactive TTY allocated by python on {host}. No SSH session associated.
templates.benign: Interactive TTY allocated by python on {host}. No SSH session associated.
templates.benign_cause: an interactive debugger attached inside a container

templates.rule: Suspicious Child Execution via Web Server
templates.intrusion: Web service process spawned {proc} on {host}.
templates.benign: Web service process spawned {proc} on {host}.
templates.benign_cause: a deploy hook that runs under the web service account

templates.rule: Decoded Payload Piped to Interpreter
templates.intrusion: base64 output piped to an interpreter on {host}, {n} occurrences.
templates.benign: base64 output piped to an interpreter on {host}, {n} occurrences.
templates.benign_cause: a packaging step that stores an encoded config blob and decodes it at runtime

templates.rule: Executable created in world-writable path
templates.intrusion: {n} files written to /tmp with exec bit set within {secs}s.
templates.benign: {n} files written to /tmp with exec bit set within {secs}s.
templates.benign_cause: compiler output and pip wheel builds

templates.rule: Payload Downloaded via Curl or Wget by Web Server
templates.intrusion: curl retrieved {size} to {path} under the service account on {host}.
templates.benign: curl retrieved {size} to {path} under the service account on {host}.
templates.benign_cause: a cached asset being fetched during container warm-up

templates.rule: File written then executed within seconds
templates.intrusion: File {path} created and executed {secs}s later on {host}.
templates.benign: File {path} created and executed {secs}s later on {host}.
templates.benign_cause: a compile-then-run test step

templates.rule: DNS Request by Recently Created Executable
templates.intrusion: Binary created {mins} min ago issued {n} DNS lookups on {host}.
templates.benign: Binary created {mins} min ago issued {n} DNS lookups on {host}.
templates.benign_cause: a freshly built binary running its integration tests

templates.rule: File Download from or Upload to Hosting Service
templates.intrusion: {size} transferred to an external file hosting domain from {host}.
templates.benign: {size} transferred to an external file hosting domain from {host}.
templates.benign_cause: a model artefact published to the team's usual sharing service

templates.rule: Outbound volume above baseline to permitted destination
templates.intrusion: {size} egress to mirror proxy in {mins} min. Container baseline {base} per hour. Destination is on the permitted egress allowlist.
templates.benign: {size} egress to mirror proxy in {mins} min. Container baseline {base} per hour. Destination is on the permitted egress allowlist.
templates.benign_cause: a large image layer pull after a base image change

templates.rule: Archive created and removed within minutes
templates.intrusion: Archive {path} created ({size}) and deleted {mins} min later on {host}.
templates.benign: Archive {path} created ({size}) and deleted {mins} min later on {host}.
templates.benign_cause: an intermediate build artefact cleaned up by the job's teardown step

templates.rule: DNS Request to Suspicious File Upload/Download Service
templates.intrusion: {n} lookups for file sharing domains from {host}, none seen from this pool before.
templates.benign: {n} lookups for file sharing domains from {host}, none seen from this pool before.
templates.benign_cause: a dependency whose documentation build pulls example data from a sharing link

templates.rule: Periodic outbound connection pattern
templates.intrusion: Connections to mirror proxy at {interval}s +/- {jitter}s intervals for {mins} min. Destination is on the permitted egress allowlist.
templates.benign: Connections to mirror proxy at {interval}s +/- {jitter}s intervals for {mins} min. Destination is on the permitted egress allowlist.
templates.benign_cause: a telemetry heartbeat on a fixed poll interval

templates.rule: Long-lived connection to permitted destination
templates.intrusion: Single connection open {hrs}h to mirror proxy from {ctr}. Pool median session {med}s.
templates.benign: Single connection open {hrs}h to mirror proxy from {ctr}. Pool median session {med}s.
templates.benign_cause: a long-running download over a slow link, or a keepalive held by a client library

templates.rule: Repeated connection retries after block
templates.intrusion: {n} blocked outbound attempts to {k} distinct destinations from {ctr} over {mins} min.
templates.benign: {n} blocked outbound attempts to {k} distinct destinations from {ctr} over {mins} min.
templates.benign_cause: a library with a hardcoded upstream that the allowlist does not include, retrying on failure

templates.rule: Outbound pattern resumes after container restart
templates.intrusion: Container {ctr} restarted; identical outbound interval pattern resumed within {secs}s.
templates.benign: Container {ctr} restarted; identical outbound interval pattern resumed within {secs}s.
templates.benign_cause: a service resuming its normal poll schedule after a restart

templates.rule: Audit log gap on host
templates.intrusion: No audit records from {host} for {mins} min. Agent reports healthy either side of the gap.
templates.benign: No audit records from {host} for {mins} min. Agent reports healthy either side of the gap.
templates.benign_cause: agent restart during node patching, or a shipper backlog

templates.rule: Shell history file truncated
templates.intrusion: History file for the service account on {host} reduced from {before} to {after} lines.
templates.benign: History file for the service account on {host} reduced from {before} to {after} lines.
templates.benign_cause: container image rebuild resetting the filesystem

templates.rule: System binary name executed from unexpected path
templates.intrusion: Process named {proc} executed from {path} on {host}, not the packaged location.
templates.benign: Process named {proc} executed from {path} on {host}, not the packaged location.
templates.benign_cause: a tool installed into a user-local bin directory by a setup script

templates.rule: Kubernetes Secret get or list from Node or Pod Service Account
templates.intrusion: Service account {sa} read {n} secrets via the API. SA is shared across {k} CI pipelines. Read scope.
templates.benign: Service account {sa} read {n} secrets via the API. SA is shared across {k} CI pipelines. Read scope.
templates.benign_cause: the shared CI credential doing exactly what it always does at the start of a pipeline run

templates.rule: Kubernetes Rapid Secret GET Activity Against Multiple Objects
templates.intrusion: {n} secret GET calls against {k} distinct objects in {secs}s by {sa}.
templates.benign: {n} secret GET calls against {k} distinct objects in {secs}s by {sa}.
templates.benign_cause: a secrets-sync controller reconciling after a config change

templates.rule: Kubernetes Service Account Token Created via TokenRequest API
templates.intrusion: {n} tokens minted for {sa} via TokenRequest in {mins} min.
templates.benign: {n} tokens minted for {sa} via TokenRequest in {mins} min.
templates.benign_cause: short-lived token rotation working as designed under a burst of pod starts

templates.rule: Kubernetes Privileged Pod Created
templates.intrusion: Privileged pod created in ns:{ns} by {sa}.
templates.benign: Privileged pod created in ns:{ns} by {sa}.
templates.benign_cause: a node-level agent that legitimately requires privilege, redeployed

templates.intrusion: Container in ns:{ns} requested {k} additional capabilities.
templates.benign: Container in ns:{ns} requested {k} additional capabilities.

templates.rule: Kubernetes Denied Service Account Request via Unusual User Agent
templates.intrusion: {n} denied requests by {sa} from user agent '{ua}'.
templates.benign: {n} denied requests by {sa} from user agent '{ua}'.

templates.rule: Package retrieved outside declared dependency set
templates.intrusion: {n} packages fetched via mirror proxy, none in the lockfile or its resolved transitive set.
templates.benign: {n} packages fetched via mirror proxy, none in the lockfile or its resolved transitive set.

templates.benign: {n} packages resolved to versions other than the pinned ones.
